import csv
from io import StringIO

# Read the CSV data
csv_data = """sku,name,category,stock,reorder_point,unit_cost
SKU-001,anchor bolt,fasteners,3,20,46.88
SKU-002,hex nut,fasteners,35,40,32.63
SKU-003,lock washer,fasteners,30,20,9.32
SKU-004,rivet,fasteners,76,40,22.54
SKU-005,wood screw,fasteners,6,20,15.73
SKU-006,toggle,fasteners,17,20,24.89
SKU-007,brass hinge,hardware,9,20,39.91
SKU-008,door stop,hardware,4,10,26.32
SKU-009,drawer slide,hardware,23,20,57.91
SKU-010,gate latch,hardware,17,20,52.40
SKU-011,hasp,hardware,88,40,23.12
SKU-012,pull,hardware,35,25,55.68
SKU-013,cable reel,electrical,2,25,55.57
SKU-014,junction box,electrical,85,50,36.82
SKU-015,wire nut,electrical,18,20,33.87
SKU-016,conduit,electrical,110,50,7.67
SKU-017,breaker,electrical,22,20,59.58
SKU-018,relay,electrical,56,25,43.19
SKU-019,drill bit set,tools,3,25,13.29
SKU-020,hole saw,tools,149,50,19.95
SKU-021,level,tools,78,50,31.26
SKU-022,pry bar,tools,72,25,55.68
SKU-023,tape measure,tools,60,40,33.70
SKU-024,vise,tools,75,50,46.59"""

reader = csv.DictReader(StringIO(csv_data))
items = []

for row in reader:
    sku = row['sku']
    stock = int(row['stock'])
    unit_cost = float(row['unit_cost'])
    stock_value = stock * unit_cost
    items.append((sku, stock_value))

# Sort by stock value in descending order

# Get top 3

print("Top 3 items by stock value:")
for sku, value in top_3:
    print(f"{sku}: {value:.2f}")

# Format answer
answer = ", ".join([sku for sku, _ in top_3])
print(f"\nAnswer: {answer}")
